# Systematic Debugging

Use this skill when something is broken and guessing would waste time.

## Workflow

1. Reproduce the problem clearly.
2. Gather the smallest evidence that shows the failure.
3. Form one root-cause hypothesis at a time.
4. Test the hypothesis before editing.
5. Fix the confirmed cause.
6. Verify the original problem is gone.

## Guardrails

- Do not stack multiple guesses together.
- Do not call it fixed without proof.
- Keep notes short and evidence-based.
